problem: Windows laptop cannot see the office Wi-Fi network
solution: Confirm Wi-Fi is enabled, toggle airplane mode off, restart the wireless adapter, and reconnect to the corporate SSID. If it remains missing, check whether the access point is broadcasting and escalate to network support.

problem: Connected to Wi-Fi but websites do not load
solution: Disconnect and reconnect to the corporate network, then renew the IP lease. Check whether other users are affected; if so, escalate as a possible network outage.

problem: VPN says credentials are invalid even though I can sign in elsewhere
solution: Verify the username format and account status, then update the saved VPN credentials. If the account is locked, request an account unlock from IT.

problem: VPN disconnects every few minutes while working from home
solution: Restart the VPN client and router, check for client updates, and reconnect using a stable network. Collect client logs and escalate if disconnections continue.

problem: Network drive is unavailable after signing in
solution: Confirm VPN or office network connectivity, then reconnect the mapped drive using the approved path. Check permissions if the share remains inaccessible.

problem: Wi-Fi keeps asking for the password on my laptop
solution: Forget the corporate wireless profile and reconnect with the current credentials. Confirm device time is correct and the account is not locked.

problem: I cannot print to the shared office printer
solution: Check that the printer is online and connected to the correct network, clear stuck jobs, and restart the print spooler. Reinstall the approved printer queue if needed.

problem: Print jobs remain stuck in the queue
solution: Cancel the stuck jobs, restart the Print Spooler service, and send a one-page test print. Escalate if the queue immediately stalls again.

problem: Printer shows offline but it has power
solution: Check the printer network cable or Wi-Fi connection, confirm the selected printer port, and restart the printer and workstation.

problem: The printer output has a paper jam warning
solution: Open the indicated access panels and remove paper gently in the feed direction. Reload paper and run a test print; request hardware support if the warning persists.

problem: My account is locked after too many login attempts
solution: Wait for the lockout period or request an IT account unlock. After access is restored, update saved passwords on devices that may be retrying old credentials.

problem: I forgot my Windows password and cannot sign in
solution: Use the organization's approved password reset portal from a trusted device. If self-service reset is unavailable, verify identity with the helpdesk for a reset.

problem: Password reset portal does not accept my verification code
solution: Check the device clock and request a fresh verification code. If the registered method is no longer available, contact IT to verify identity and update recovery details.

problem: I can sign in to email but cannot open the shared folder
solution: Confirm you are using the correct work account and that the folder is shared with it. Ask the folder owner to verify permissions; escalate access changes through IT.

problem: My new employee account does not have access to the finance application
solution: Confirm onboarding is complete and ask the manager to submit the required application access request. IT should verify role-based approval before granting access.

problem: Outlook keeps prompting me to enter my password
solution: Close and reopen Outlook, confirm the account password works in webmail, then remove stale saved credentials and sign in again. Escalate if prompts continue.

problem: Email messages are not syncing to Outlook
solution: Check network connectivity and service status, then restart Outlook and trigger a folder sync. Recreate the mail profile if sync remains broken.

problem: I cannot send email attachments because the message is too large
solution: Reduce the attachment size or share the file using the organization's approved cloud storage link. Confirm recipient access before sending.

problem: My mailbox says it is over the storage limit
solution: Delete or archive unneeded large messages and empty Deleted Items. If the mailbox remains full, request an approved quota review.

problem: Outlook calendar invitations are missing from my inbox
solution: Check Junk Email, focused inbox, and calendar settings, then verify the correct mailbox is open. Ask the sender to resend if the invitation was not delivered.

problem: Teams microphone is not detected during a meeting
solution: Confirm the microphone is connected and selected in Teams device settings, allow microphone access in system privacy settings, then restart Teams and test again.

problem: Teams will not let me share my screen
solution: Confirm the meeting role permits screen sharing, choose the correct window, and restart Teams. Ask the meeting organizer to adjust permissions if sharing is restricted.

problem: Video calls freeze when I turn on my camera
solution: Close other camera applications, check network quality, and update or reconnect the camera. Lower video resolution or use audio while the issue is investigated.

problem: I cannot open a shared document link from Teams
solution: Verify that you are signed into the account that received access and open the link in a browser. Ask the owner to confirm sharing permissions.

problem: Teams desktop app will not start after an update
solution: Restart the computer, confirm the update completed, then clear the Teams application cache using approved support steps. Reinstall the managed app if it still fails.

problem: Software installation is blocked because I need administrator rights
solution: Use the organization's software catalog or submit a software request for approval. Do not bypass device controls; IT can install approved software.

problem: Company portal installation fails with a download error
solution: Check network access and available disk space, restart the company portal, and retry the installation. Record the error code for endpoint support if it fails again.

problem: An application disappeared after the latest update
solution: Check the approved software catalog and application list, restart the device, and reinstall the managed application. Escalate if the application is no longer assigned.

problem: The software installer says this app is not compatible with my computer
solution: Verify the device operating system and architecture against the supported version. Request the approved compatible package from IT.

problem: I need an update to an application but do not have permission
solution: Use the managed software catalog to request the update. IT should confirm compatibility and apply it through the approved deployment process.

problem: My laptop battery drains quickly even when sleeping
solution: Check battery usage and power settings, install approved firmware updates, and fully restart the laptop. Request a battery health check if runtime remains unusually short.

problem: Laptop fan is loud and computer feels hot
solution: Move the laptop to a clear ventilated surface, close resource-heavy applications, and restart. Contact hardware support if overheating or shutdowns continue.

problem: External monitor says no signal when connected to my laptop
solution: Check the cable and input source, reconnect the dock, and use the display settings to detect the monitor. Test another cable or port if available.

problem: Laptop keyboard has several keys that do not respond
solution: Restart the computer and check whether the issue occurs with an external keyboard. Submit a hardware repair request if the built-in keys still fail.

problem: My computer is running slowly since this morning
solution: Restart the computer, check available disk space and resource usage, and close unnecessary applications. Run approved endpoint checks and escalate if performance remains poor.

problem: The laptop freezes randomly during normal work
solution: Install pending approved updates, note the applications and times involved, and check system resource usage. Escalate with diagnostic logs if freezing continues.

problem: The computer takes a very long time to boot
solution: Restart and allow managed startup updates to finish, check free storage, and disable unnecessary startup applications. Ask endpoint support to review boot diagnostics if needed.

problem: I see a disk space warning on my work computer
solution: Use the approved storage cleanup tool, remove unneeded downloads, and move work files to approved storage. Contact IT if system storage remains low.

problem: My browser crashes when I open many work tabs
solution: Update the managed browser, disable unnecessary extensions, and reopen tabs gradually. Clear the browser cache if crashes continue.

problem: I received a suspicious email asking me to verify my account
solution: Do not click links or open attachments. Report the message using the organization's phishing-report process and delete it after reporting.

problem: My antivirus says a file was quarantined
solution: Do not restore or open the file. Record the alert details and contact security support to verify whether the detection is expected.

problem: I accidentally clicked a link in an email that may be phishing
solution: Report the message to security immediately. If credentials were entered, change the password using a trusted route and contact IT security for next steps.

problem: My work phone is lost and has company email on it
solution: Report the lost device to IT immediately so access can be revoked and the device remotely wiped if available. Change credentials if security advises.

problem: A browser warns that a website certificate is not trusted
solution: Do not bypass the warning or enter credentials. Check the URL and report the certificate warning to IT security for investigation.

problem: I need to set up a replacement work phone
solution: Install the managed company portal, enroll the device using the approved setup guide, and contact IT if enrollment fails or the device is not assigned.

problem: Company email is not syncing on my work phone
solution: Confirm the device is enrolled and online, then refresh the mail account and restart the phone. Re-enroll only using the approved mobile device process.

problem: The authenticator app is not showing a sign-in prompt
solution: Check network access and device time, open the authenticator app, and retry sign-in. If the device changed, contact IT to reset the registered authentication method.

problem: My phone says it is not compliant with company policy
solution: Open the company portal and review the listed compliance action, such as installing an update or enabling a screen lock. Contact IT if the device remains noncompliant.

problem: I cannot enroll my tablet in the company portal
solution: Confirm the tablet meets supported OS requirements and is assigned for enrollment. Update the portal app and contact endpoint support with the enrollment error.

problem: The company intranet page returns a not found error
solution: Verify the address and try the approved home page link. Check whether the site is available to other users and contact the site owner if the page was moved.

problem: Internal website keeps redirecting me to the login page
solution: Clear site cookies, confirm the correct work account, and retry in a supported browser. Escalate with the page URL and timestamp if the redirect continues.

problem: A web application works in one browser but not another
solution: Use the supported managed browser, update it, and clear site data for the affected application. Report reproducible browser-specific errors to application support.

problem: I cannot access the internal portal while connected to VPN
solution: Confirm VPN is connected to the required profile, verify the portal URL, and retry after reconnecting. Contact network support if internal DNS or routing fails.

problem: The web page is blank after I sign in
solution: Refresh the page, clear site data, and disable unsupported extensions. Check service status and capture browser console details for application support if unresolved.
